report_text: fire and heavy damage
technician entered hydrocarbon storage vessel c-102 for internal inspection before conducting oxygen and toxic gas level tests. forced ventilation was off.
high pressure gas line psv valve isolated with blind flange during routine maintenance without lock-out tag-out (loto) key isolation or supervisor approval.
high voltage 11kv electrical breaker panel left open and energized with exposed live busbars while technician cleaned surrounding floor with wet mop.
excavation crew dug 2.5m deep trench near high voltage buried cable without cable locator survey or shoring support on loose soil bank.
worker observed working on scaffolding platform at 18 meters height without securing safety harness lanyard to life line. life line was missing lock snap hook.
operator bypassed interlock safety trip on main compressor emergency shutdown system to bypass false alarms during night shift.
overhead crane lifting operationsing operationsing operationsed 12-ton drill collar using damaged synthetic web sling showing severe cut marks and fraying. rigger was standing directly beneath load.
scaffolding plank cracked and unpinned on 4th level platform. scaffolder stepped on plank edge causing it to tilt, narrowly avoiding fall.
electrical isolation lock removed from valve actuator motor before mechanical tag-out verification was completed.
excavator operator swung bucket over worker standing inside 2m deep un-shored trench to hand over tools.
atmospheric air sampling in nitrogen purged vessel showed 16% oxygen content. permit issued without gas testing re-verify.
hot work welding was being conducted near crude oil manifold line without gas testing or hot work permit posted. flammable gas meter was not calibrated.
scaffolding erection commenced without green tag safety permit or inspector signature on rig mast.
confined space attendant left entry hatch unattended while 2 contractors were cleaning sludge inside oil pit.
heavy 500kg manifold valve suspended on forklift forks using uncertified fiber rope over active walkway.
welding cable insulation damaged with exposed copper conductors lying in puddle of water near flare stack.
worker operating metal cutoff saw without eye protection or spark shield near open diesel drum storage area.
worker standing on top rung of 10-foot wooden ladder reaching overhead to turn valve near unguarded floor opening.
tanker driver reversed heavy crude tanker without guide or reversing alarm horn activated near loading rack.
diesel generator neutral earth grounding cable disconnected during battery swap and engine started.
un-shored excavation collapsed partially on side wall following rain; worker jumped out 30 seconds prior.
contractor oil tanker driver observed driving at 65 km/h in 30 km/h refinery zone without wearing seatbelt while using mobile phone.
main hoist wire rope on well servicing rig had 4 broken wires per strand and severe localized corrosion.
rig floor assistant standing in pinch zone between rotating kelly spinner and tong line during pipe connection operations.
speeding vehicle driving vehicle driving vehicle driving pickup truck overtook heavy supply truck on narrow unpaved lease road near blind curve.

safety notice poster on emergency assembly point board was faded and partially detached due to rain.
contractor vehicle parked slightly outside designated yellow parking grid near main office entrance.
worker forgot to wear safety glasses inside tool shed while reading manual. no flying debris or grinding in progress.
housekeeping issue: empty plastic water bottles and paper cups left on breakroom table.
rupture disc indicator light bulb fused on control panel b-04. panel alarm audible speaker functioning properly.
hydraulic hose on mobile crane showed minor outer rubber abrasion. hose pressure checked normal; replaced during planned pm.
worker slipped on mud on walkway during heavy rain but caught handrail, no injury sustained.
grinding dust accumulated on bench vice table in mechanical workshop. swept and cleaned.
safety helmet chin strap unbuckled while worker carried clipboard across administrative area.
insulation jacket missing on low pressure steam pipe branch in boiler area. surface temperature 60 deg c.
walkway handrail loose at 2 points near chemical dosing skid. area cordoned off for repairs.
emergency response team stretcher cabinet door latch stuck. lubricated and tested smooth operation.
toolbox talk attendance sheet not filled completely for morning shift team.
fire extinguisher pressure gauge needle in red re-charge zone outside control room 3. unit replaced immediately.
